name: K8s-Hetzner Cloud Architect Environment
postCreateCommand: wget -O /tmp/hcloud.tar.gz https://github.com/hetznercloud/cli/releases/latest/download/hcloud-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xvzf /tmp/hcloud.tar.gz -C /tmp && sudo mv /tmp/hcloud /usr/local/bin/ && rm /tmp/hcloud.tar.gz
wget -O /tmp/packer.zip https://releases.hashicorp.com/packer/1.10.0/packer_1.10.0_linux_amd64.zip && unzip /tmp/packer.zip && sudo mv packer /usr/local/bin/ && rm /tmp/packer.zip'
